reviewerInstructionsSubmitted: Windows, Chrome 120+. Install HABITAT: https://github.com/aesgalexis/habitat/releases/latest. In desktop 0.9.1: Preferences > Browser > Google Chrome. Enable connection on extension welcome page; keep app running. Google/YouTube/Translate: submit a synthetic query or translate Hello world; no account needed. ChatGPT: sign in on chatgpt.com, open a conversation, then submit a synthetic message from HABITAT. No HABITAT account or API key. Clear search closes its tab.
